full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

measurementRules.rule: Use calibrated actual net whole-product mass at the fixed completed-finish first gate. Exclude every tare; preserve original Q, actual moisture/finish and event genealogy via cp_acceptance and cp_cohorts.

Use actual finished-state width/length/mass records and method uncertainty; strip apparent width≤5mm. The reported100D→1000/9dtex is a case unit conversion only, not a grade default. No inferred thickness/density.
Record whole aqueous mixture once, all actual solutes/water separately nested. Reactive species and actual elemental/water balances follow cp_materials/cp_species, not formula defaults.

measurementRules.required_property: Whole physical mass and compatible service units
measurementRules.rule: Preserve physical Qt/fleet once and distinct attributableA/Q service vectors. Qt/Qanalysis is an analytical physical display, never automatic duplicate treatment demand.

calculationRules.rule: Q=sum unique original positive net first-acceptance events at one fixed gate and declared state; returns/rework/retests do not create another event. Keep full general stock/disposition bridge and original-basis conversions separately.

Construct attributableA from actual openingWIP historical vectors plus incurred period loads including failure/rework, less evidenced closingWIP carry and separately traced dispositions; later services retain original cohorts/Q. No duplicated provider-embedded history. Physical transfers and all stocks remain full independently of A.
calculationRules.output: attributable A by original cohort and provider unit

calculationRules.rule: For each modelled exchange, divide attributable actualA in its compatible provider unit by the original positive Q inkg exactly once; output flat_strip isQ/Q=1kg. Raw whole wasteQt and physical analyticalQt/Qanalysis do not automatically equal each cohortA/Q treatment demand. Zero/unknownQ keeps raw totals unresolved.

Maintain independent whole-mass and C/S/Na/Zn balances plus actual cellulose, solute, species, moisture and finish subledgers. Cellulose/xanthate, CS2, H2S, acid/alkali and bleach are reactive; do not conserve each reacting species across the plant. Free water in supplied solutions, steam/condensate, evaporated water, crystal water and actual reaction-water formation/consumption require distinct evidence and actual reaction extents. Do not infer two unknowns from a fitted closure or force theoretical chemistry to supply a recipe/yield. Gas amounts use concentration times matched integrated gas volume, or integration of a measured rate; never multiply an integrated volume by time again. COD is an indicator, not a specific organic species or extra wastewater mass.

measurementRules.rule: 在固定完整整理后首次关口采用校准实测完整产品净质量。排除全部皮重；经cp_acceptance和cp_cohorts保留原Q、实际水/油剂及事件谱系。
采用实际整理后宽/长/质量记录及方法不确定度；条带表观宽度≤5mm。报告100D→1000/9dtex仅为实例单位换算，不是牌号默认。不推定厚度/密度。
完整水溶混合物记录一次，实际溶质/水分别嵌套。反应物种及实际元素/水平衡按cp_materials/cp_species，不采用化学式默认。

measurementRules.required_property: 完整实物质量及兼容服务单位
measurementRules.rule: 完整保留一次物理Qt/物品群，并另列可归属A/Q服务向量。Qt/Qanalysis是实物分析展示，不是自动重复处理需求。

calculationRules.rule: Q=同一固定关口及声明状态下唯一原始正净质量首次验收事件之和；退回/返工/复验不再新增事件。另保留完整一般存量/去向桥接和原基准换算。
实际期初在制历史向量加已发生期间负荷（含失败/返工），减有证据期末在制承继及单独追踪去向，构造可归属A；后续服务保留原队列/Q。不重复提供者内嵌历史。实物交接与全部存量独立于A保留全量。
calculationRules.output: 按原队列及提供者单位的可归属A

calculationRules.rule: 每个建模交换以兼容提供者单位的实际可归属A除原正值Q（kg），恰好一次；flat_strip为Q/Q=1kg。原始完整废物Qt及实物分析Qt/Qanalysis不自动等于各队列A/Q处理需求。Q为零/未知时保留原始总量及未解决状态。

独立保持整物流质量与C/S/Na/Zn平衡，以及实际纤维素、溶质、物种、水分和油剂分账。纤维素/黄原酸酯、CS2、H2S、酸碱及漂白剂参与反应，不能跨厂逐一守恒反应物种。供入溶液游离水、蒸汽/冷凝水、蒸发水、结晶水及实际反应生成/消耗水须分别有证据和实际反应程度。不得用拟合闭合同时反推两个未知数，或用理论化学强配配方/收率。气体量采用浓度乘对应累计体积，或对实测速率积分，不能再给累计体积乘时间。COD是指标，不是特定有机物种或额外废水质量。
calculationRules.output: 完整物理/元素/物种/水平衡及不确定性

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 不遗漏已知设备、回收、化学品、处理或公用工程；全部真实交换须完整链接及补充原子行。
独立保持全部实物存量/交接、原验收事件及非重叠可归属环境/提供者服务向量。
保留全部来源限定及反向证据；专利/报告/BREF数值不得成为配方、收率、系数、清单默认或提供者可用证明。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: section9; source originals; actual methods/provider records
